reading.title: Yummy World（美食世界）
reading.intro: 李一家人昨天到美食世界（Yummy World）吃午餐。閱讀他們在各餐廳的對話和網上食評，學習點餐和評價食物的表達：

paragraphs.text: The Lee family went to Yummy World for lunch yesterday. There are four fast food shops there: Little Tokyo, Thai Curry, Bravo and Red Dragon.
paragraphs.translation: 李一家人昨天去美食世界吃午餐。那裡有四間快餐店：Little Tokyo、Thai Curry、Bravo 和 Red Dragon。
sentences: The Lee family went to Yummy World for lunch yesterday.
There are four fast food shops there: Little Tokyo, Thai Curry, Bravo and Red Dragon.
translation_sentences: 李一家人昨天去美食世界吃午餐。
那裡有四間快餐店：Little Tokyo、Thai Curry、Bravo 和 Red Dragon。

paragraphs.text: “What do you want?” asks the waiter at Little Tokyo. “Umm ... I’d like the chicken curry and miso soup, please,” says Sam. At Thai Curry, the waiter asks, “Would you like to try our spicy beef curry?” “No, thanks. I don’t like spicy food,” says Pam. “I don’t like spicy food, either,” says Sam.
paragraphs.translation: 「你想吃什麼？」Little Tokyo 的侍應問。「嗯……我想要雞肉咖喱和味噌湯，」Sam 說。在 Thai Curry，侍應問：「你想試試我們的辣牛肉咖喱嗎？」「不了，謝謝。我不喜歡辣的食物，」Pam 說。「我也不喜歡辣的食物，」Sam 說。

pairs.en: I don’t like spicy food, either

「不了，謝謝。我不喜歡辣的食物，」Pam 說。
「我也不喜歡辣的食物，」Sam 說。

paragraphs.text: At Bravo, the waiter asks, “Would you like to try our tiramisu?” “Yes. I’d like to have one, please,” says Pam. At Red Dragon, Brian says, “I like spring rolls! I’d like to order those!” Clara says, “I like spring rolls, too. Let’s get some!”
paragraphs.translation: 在 Bravo，侍應問：「你想試試我們的提拉米蘇嗎？」「好的，我想要一個，」Pam 說。在 Red Dragon，Brian 說：「我喜歡春卷！我想點那些！」Clara 說：「我也喜歡春卷。我們點一些吧！」

“Yes. I’d like to have one, please,” says Pam.
At Red Dragon, Brian says, “I like spring rolls! I’d like to order those!”
Clara says, “I like spring rolls, too. Let’s get some!”

在 Red Dragon，Brian 說：「我喜歡春卷！我想點那些！」
Clara 說：「我也喜歡春卷。我們點一些吧！」

paragraphs.text: The Lee family wrote reviews on a website about the fast food shops they visited. Sam wrote: “I ordered chicken curry and miso soup at Little Tokyo yesterday. The chicken curry looked attractive but it tasted awful! The food was cold and the spoons were dirty. The staff were not polite or helpful. Next to Little Tokyo is Thai Curry. Their chicken curry and satay looked more attractive than Little Tokyo’s!”
paragraphs.translation: 李一家人在網站上寫了關於他們光顧的快餐店的食評。Sam 寫道：「我昨天在 Little Tokyo 點了雞肉咖喱和味噌湯。雞肉咖喱看起來很好看，但味道很糟糕！食物是冷的，湯匙很髒。員工不禮貌也不幫忙。Little Tokyo 旁邊是 Thai Curry。他們的雞肉咖喱和沙嗲看起來比 Little Tokyo 的更好看！」

pairs.en: The staff were not polite or helpful

“I ordered chicken curry and miso soup at Little Tokyo yesterday.
The chicken curry looked attractive but it tasted awful!
The food was cold and the spoons were dirty.

「我昨天在 Little Tokyo 點了雞肉咖喱和味噌湯。

員工不禮貌也不幫忙。
Little Tokyo 旁邊是 Thai Curry。
他們的雞肉咖喱和沙嗲看起來比 Little Tokyo 的更好看！」

paragraphs.text: Pam wrote about Bravo: “Bravo is a new fast food shop at Yummy World. A lot of people queued up at the shop. I waited 30 minutes for my food! The spaghetti with meatballs was a little bit spicy. There was a lot of cheese on the top, but it was not too salty. I also tried the tiramisu. I think it is the most delicious tiramisu in Hong Kong. The food tasted wonderful but it was quite expensive. The service needs improvement.”
paragraphs.translation: Pam 寫了關於 Bravo 的食評：「Bravo 是美食世界新開的快餐店。很多人在店前排隊。我等了 30 分鐘才拿到食物！肉丸意大利麵有一點辣。上面有很多芝士，但不會太鹹。我也試了提拉米蘇。我覺得它是全香港最美味的提拉米蘇。食物味道很好，但相當昂貴。服務需要改進。」

paragraphs.text: Clara wrote about Red Dragon: “My husband and I ordered some spring rolls at Red Dragon yesterday. They were crispy and not too oily. We also had roasted goose with rice. The goose was tasty but the food was not enough. We were still hungry when we finished. However, the staff were friendly and the prices were the most reasonable at Yummy World.”
paragraphs.translation: Clara 寫了關於 Red Dragon 的食評：「我丈夫和我昨天在 Red Dragon 點了一些春卷。它們很香脆，不太油膩。我們還吃了燒鵝配飯。燒鵝很美味，但食物不夠。我們吃完時還是很餓。不過，員工很友善，價錢也是美食世界裡最合理的。」

listening.title: 聆聽練習：Curry Hut 問卷調查
listening.description: Sam 和 Pam 正在 Curry Hut 填寫意見問卷。聆聽對話，完成問卷：

script.title: Sam & Pam：Curry Hut 意見問卷（聆聽稿）
script.text: Sam and Pam are filling in a questionnaire at Curry Hut. The waiter asks, “Which dishes did you order?” Sam says, “We ordered the chicken curry and the beef curry.” The waiter asks, “How was the food?” Pam says, “It was very delicious and very hot.” The waiter asks, “How was the price?” Sam says, “I think the price is reasonable.” Pam says, “Yes, the price is reasonable.” The waiter asks, “How were the staff?” Pam says, “The staff were friendly, but the service was slow.” Sam says, “Also, the forks were dirty. We asked for clean ones.”

segments.en: Sam and Pam are filling in a questionnaire at Curry Hut.
segments.zh: Sam 和 Pam 正在 Curry Hut 填寫意見問卷。

segments.en: We ordered the chicken curry and the beef curry.
segments.zh: 我們點了雞肉咖喱和牛肉咖喱。

segments.en: It was very delicious and very hot.
I think the price is reasonable.
The staff were friendly, but the service was slow.
segments.zh: 員工很友善，但服務很慢。

script.zh: Sam 和 Pam 正在 Curry Hut 填寫意見問卷。侍應問：「你們點了哪些菜？」Sam 說：「我們點了雞肉咖喱和牛肉咖喱。」侍應問：「食物怎麼樣？」Pam 說：「非常美味，而且很辣。」侍應問：「價錢怎麼樣？」Sam 說：「我覺得價錢合理。」Pam 說：「是的，價錢合理。」侍應問：「員工怎麼樣？」Pam 說：「員工很友善，但服務很慢。」Sam 說：「而且，叉子很髒。我們要了乾淨的。」

questions.before: 1. Which dish(es) did you order? curry (a)
questions.explanation: Sam 說 We ordered the chicken curry and the beef curry，所以第一個是 chicken。

questions.before: 2. Which dish(es) did you order? curry (a) chicken and curry (b)
questions.explanation: Sam 說 We ordered the chicken curry and the beef curry，所以第二個是 beef。
Pam 說 It was very delicious and very hot，食物非常美味。
Sam 和 Pam 都說 the price is reasonable，價錢合理。
Pam 說 The staff were friendly, but the service was slow，員工友善但服務慢。
Sam 說 the forks were dirty，叉子是髒的。

textType.title: Text Type: Food Reviews（食評）
textType.description: 食評（Food Review）告訴我們一道菜餚的價錢、味道和其他資訊。食評通常包括引言、餐廳名稱、評分、評論和價錢。

model.title: WHO MAKES THE BEST SPRING ROLLS IN TOWN?（誰是鎮上最好吃的春卷？）
model.body: This week, we compared the spring rolls from three Chinese restaurants. Let’s see which one is the best! Red Dragon: They are very crispy and not too oily, but there’s not enough pork. Price: $14. White Star: They are oily and cold! Yuck! Price: $17. Peking Taste: They are crispy and spicy. The sauce tastes wonderful. Price: $22.
model.zh: 本週，我們比較了三間中餐館的春卷。看看哪一間最好！Red Dragon：春卷非常香脆，不太油膩，但豬肉不夠。價錢：14美元。White Star：春卷油膩又冷！噁！價錢：17美元。Peking Taste：春卷香脆又辣。醬汁味道很棒。價錢：22美元。
sentences: This week, we compared the spring rolls from three Chinese restaurants.
Let’s see which one is the best!
Red Dragon: They are very crispy and not too oily, but there’s not enough pork.
Price: $14.
White Star: They are oily and cold! Yuck!
Price: $17.
Peking Taste: They are crispy and spicy.
The sauce tastes wonderful.
Price: $22.
translation_sentences: 本週，我們比較了三間中餐館的春卷。
看看哪一間最好！
Red Dragon：春卷非常香脆，不太油膩，但豬肉不夠。
價錢：14美元。
White Star：春卷油膩又冷！噁！
價錢：17美元。
Peking Taste：春卷香脆又辣。
醬汁味道很棒。
價錢：22美元。

questions.text: 1. What is NOT in the food review?

options.text: d. opening hours of the restaurants

questions.explanation: 食評包含味道、餐廳名稱和價錢，但沒有營業時間，所以選 d。

questions.text: 2. This food review is from ____.
questions.explanation: 食評來自 Smart Kids Weekly（雜誌），所以選 a。

questions.text: 3. Which restaurant’s spring rolls are the most expensive?
questions.explanation: Peking Taste 的春卷售價 $22，是三間中最貴的，所以選 c。

questions.text: 4. What does the reviewer think of Red Dragon’s spring rolls?

options.text: a. crispy and not too oily

questions.explanation: 食評說 Red Dragon 的春卷 very crispy and not too oily，所以選 a。

practice.intro: 根據 Unit 4（At the food court）內容完成以下練習題：

readingComp.title: 練習 1：閱讀理解選擇題
readingComp.description: 根據課文內容，選擇最佳答案：

questions.text: 1. What does Sam think of the staff at Little Tokyo?
questions.explanation: Sam 說 The staff were not polite or helpful，員工不禮貌（rude），所以選 d。
questions.zh: Sam 覺得 Little Tokyo 的員工怎麼樣？

questions.text: 2. What does Pam think of Bravo?

options.text: b. The service was very good.

questions.explanation: Pam 說 The food tasted wonderful，食物很好（excellent），所以選 a。
questions.zh: Pam 覺得 Bravo 怎麼樣？

questions.text: 3. Read Mrs Clara Lee’s review again. In line 8, the word ‘reasonable’ means ____.
questions.explanation: reasonable 意思是合理的、不太貴的，所以選 c（not too expensive）。
questions.zh: 再讀 Clara Lee 太太的食評。第 8 行中 ‘reasonable’ 是什麼意思？

readingQA.title: 練習 2：閱讀理解問答題
readingQA.description: 根據課文內容，用完整的句子回答下列問題：

questions.text: 1. What is the name of the Chinese fast food shop?
questions.answer: The name of the Chinese fast food shop is Red Dragon.
questions.explanation: Red Dragon 售賣春卷和燒鵝等中式食物，是中國快餐店。
questions.zh: 那間中式快餐店叫什麼名字？

questions.text: 2. What did Mrs Lee NOT like about her food?
questions.answer: The food was not enough. She was still hungry.
questions.explanation: Clara 說 The goose was tasty but the food was not enough，她不喜歡食物不夠吃。
questions.zh: Lee 太太不喜歡她的食物的哪一點？

questions.text: 3. Does Sam want to eat at Little Tokyo again? Why or why not?
questions.answer: No, because the food was cold and the staff were rude.
variations: No, the staff were not polite.
questions.explanation: Sam 說 The food was cold and the staff were not polite，所以不想再去。
questions.zh: Sam 想再去 Little Tokyo 吃飯嗎？為什麼？

questions.text: 4. Which fast food shop at Yummy World would you like to go to? Why?
questions.answer: I would like to go to Thai Curry because the food looks attractive.
variations: I would like to go to Red Dragon because the prices are reasonable.
questions.explanation: 開放題，自由作答。說出你想去的餐廳並給出理由即可。
questions.zh: 你想去美食世界的哪間快餐店？為什麼？

wordBank.title: 練習 3：詞庫填空（形容詞）
wordBank.description: 從詞庫中選擇正確的形容詞，完成男孩對各道菜的想法：

items.before: 1. I don’t like the beef curry. It’s
items.explanation: 牛肉咖喱很辣（spicy），所以男孩不喜歡。

items.before: 2. I don’t like the spring rolls either because it isn’t healthy eating too much
items.explanation: 太多油膩（oily）的食物不健康。

items.before: 3. I like the tiramisu. It’s sweet and
4. Many people like the salmon sushi. It’s
items.explanation: 很多人喜歡三文魚壽司，它很受歡迎（popular）。
沙嗲售價 $60 太貴（expensive），價錢不合理。
意大利麵看起來最吸引（attractive），他想試試。

comparative.title: 練習 4：比較級與最高級（Curry Hut）
comparative.description: 用括號內形容詞的正確形式填空，比較 Curry Hut 的三道菜：

items.after: (expensive) than the noodles in curry soup.
items.explanation: 比較兩道菜用 more + 形容詞（more expensive than）。

items.before: 2. The chicken curry with rice is the most
items.explanation: 比較三道或以上用 the most + 形容詞（the most delicious）。

items.before: 3. The noodles in curry soup are the most
items.explanation: 咖喱湯麵最受歡迎，用 the most popular。

sentencePattern.title: 練習 5：點餐句子（Rainbow Juice Bar）

items.explanation: Would you like something to drink/eat?（你想喝/吃點什麼嗎？）是點餐常用句。
用 I’d like ... 說出想要的東西，例如 I’d like some orange juice。

items.before: 3. How much is the peach jelly? It is
items.explanation: Rainbow Juice Bar 菜單顯示 Peach jelly 售價 $6。

discussion.title: 練習 6：討論（Crazy Dish 點子）
discussion.description: 和組員討論創意菜式，然後回答問題：

questions.text: 1. We need to give a name to our dish. Any suggestions?
questions.reference:
參考答案： How about Peanut Butter Pizza? / Shall we call it Sweet Pizza?
中文翻譯： 花生醬披薩怎麼樣？/ 我們叫它甜披薩好嗎？

questions.text: 2. Do you agree with your group’s idea? Why?
questions.reference:
參考答案： Yes, I agree with you. I agree because it is a crazy idea.
中文翻譯： 是的，我同意你。我同意，因為這是一個瘋狂的點子。

questions.text: 3. How much peanut butter do we need for the pizza?
questions.reference:
參考答案： We need 200 grams of peanut butter.
中文翻譯： 我們需要 200 克花生醬。

sections.title: 文法辨識題（每題 1 分）

questions.text: 1. Which sentence is correct?

options.text: a. Would you like to try our tiramisu?
b. You would like to try our tiramisu?
c. Would like you to try our tiramisu?
d. Would you to try like our tiramisu?

questions.explanation: 提出邀請用 Would you like to ...?，所以選 a。

questions.text: 2. I don’t like spicy food. I don’t like it, ____.
questions.explanation: 否定句表示「也（不）」用 either（not ... either），所以選 b。

sections.title: 詞彙理解題（每題 1 分）

questions.text: 1. Which word describes food with too much oil?
questions.explanation: 太多油的食物用 oily（油膩的）形容，所以選 b。

questions.text: 2. What does ‘reasonable’ mean?
questions.explanation: reasonable 意思是合理的、不太貴的（not too expensive），所以選 a。

sections.title: 閱讀理解選擇題（每題 2 分）

questions.text: 1. Why did Pam wait 30 minutes at Bravo?

options.text: b. A lot of people queued up at the shop.
c. The staff were not helpful.
d. The tiramisu was too expensive.

questions.explanation: Pam 說 A lot of people queued up at the shop，很多人排隊，所以等了 30 分鐘，選 b。

questions.text: 2. Which fast food shop did Clara think had the most reasonable prices?
questions.explanation: Clara 說 the prices were the most reasonable at Yummy World，她覺得 Red Dragon 價錢最合理，選 c。

sections.title: 點餐句填空題（每題 2 分）
sections.description: 用 would like / I’d like / too / either 填空：

questions.text: 1. ____ you like to try our spring rolls?
questions.explanation: 提出邀請用 Would you like to ...?，所以填 Would。

questions.text: 2. I like spring rolls. I like them, ____.
questions.explanation: 肯定句表示「也」用 too，所以填 too。

sections.title: 句型運用題（每題 3 分）
sections.prompt: 用 Would you like ...? 寫一句向朋友提議食物的句子：
sections.answer: Would you like to try our spring rolls?
sections.explanation: 示例：Would you like to try our spring rolls?（你想試試我們的春卷嗎？）用 Would you like to + 動詞原形提議即可。

learningPoints.title: 4A Unit 4：At the food court（在美食廣場）
goals: 能閱讀餐廳食評並理解評價內容
能認識描述食物的形容詞（attractive, delicious, expensive, oily, popular, spicy）
能用 Would you like ...? 提出邀請、I’d like ... 點餐
能用 too / not ... either 表示相同意見
能用 more ... than / the most 比較食物
能聆聽對話並完成問卷

sections.title: 1. 食物形容詞：
items: attractive, delicious, expensive, oily, popular, spicy

sections.title: 2. 點餐用語：
items: Would you like to try our tiramisu?
I’d like the chicken curry, please.
I like spring rolls, too. / I don’t like spicy food, either.

sections.title: 4. 文本類型：
items: Food Review（食評）——介紹味道、價錢、服務等資訊的文章
